data.name: Ferdinando
data.gender_notes: Ferdinando is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic 'Fitz' meaning 'son' and the Italian 'Andreas' meaning 'man, warrior'. Ferdinando is a powerful name meaning 'soldier, bold, fearless'. It is a popular name in Italy and is often given to boys born into noble families. The name Ferdinando carries the meaning “Soldier, bold, fearless” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ferdinando usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier, bold, fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the courage to face life's challenges with strength and fearlessness.
data.etymology: Ferdinando belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soldier, bold, fearless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ferdinando total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: פרדיננדו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פרדיננדו הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אדם אמיץ ונועז'. השם מורכב משני חלקים: 'פרד' שפירושו 'אמיץ' ו-'יננדו' שפירושו 'נועז'. השם נמצא בשימוש נרחב בקרב הנוצרים והוא נחשב לשם חזק ומשמעותי.

in_greek.name: Φερδινάνδο
in_greek.meaning: Φερδινάνδο σημαίνει ο τολμηρός και γενναίος άνθρωπος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φερδινάνδο προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ο τολμηρός και γενναίος άνθρωπος'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'Φερδ' που σημαίνει 'τολμηρός' και '-ινάνδο' που σημαίνει 'γενναίος'. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιείται ευρέως μεταξύ των Χριστιανών και θεωρείται ισχυρό και σημαντικό όνομα.

in_latin.name: Ferdinando
in_latin.meaning: Ferdinando means the bold and courageous man
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Ferdinando originates from the Germanic language and means 'the bold and courageous man'. The name is composed of two parts: 'Ferd' which means 'bold' and '-inando' which means 'courageous'. This name has been widely used among Christians and is considered a strong and significant name.

in_english.name: Ferdinando
in_english.meaning: Ferdinando means a bold and courageous person
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ferdinando has its roots in the Germanic language, specifically from the words 'frith' meaning 'peace' and 'nanth' meaning 'bold' or 'courageous'. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name embodies qualities highly valued in Christian traditions, such as bravery and strength. Historically, the name has been popularized by several saints and nobles, adding to its spiritual significance. Today, Ferdinando is used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing a person of great courage and determination.

data.cultural_impact: Ferdinando was the name of several notable figures in Italian history. Most notably, Ferdinando I de' Medici was the grand duke of Tuscany from 1587 to 1609. He was known for his patronage of the arts, including notable artists such as Galileo Galilei and Michelangelo.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ferdinando carries a deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the roots 'Fitz' meaning 'son' and 'Andreas' meaning 'man, warrior'. It suggests a warrior who embodies the qualities of a strong and noble son. The name Ferdinando can inspire one to strive for courage, strength, and loyalty in all areas of life. It can also serve as a reminder to be a protector, a defender, and a fighter for righteousness and good. Ultimately, the name Ferdinando may inspire one to be a warrior for the Lord, living a life full of faith and devotion to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ferdinando, meaning "bold, daring" in Germanic origin, symbolizes a courageous and fearless spirit in the face of adversity for those who bear this Christian name. Spiritually, it represents the inner strength and determination to overcome challenges, trusting in God's guidance and protection.

historical_references.reference: Born in Naples, Italy, in 1521, Ferdinando de' Medici was the Grand Duke of Tuscany from 1540 until his death in 1590.
historical_references.context: Ferdinando de' Medici was an important figure in the Italian Renaissance.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ferdinando remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
